What is this letter?
This letter is from Granite Valley Electric Cooperative.
Type of letter: Utility bill or notice.
The letter is dated Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
There are 2 important dates. The next one is Tuesday, November 17, 2026 (in 11 days).
There are 3 things you need to do.
Money in this letter: $412.37 (Amount you owe).
Important dates
The letter says:
Tuesday, November 17, 2026
Coming up
“Unless payment of the past-due amount is received by
Payment due · in 11 days
November 17, 2026, your electric service will be
disconnected on or after November 19, 2026.”
Thursday, November 19, 2026
Coming up
“Unless payment of the past-due amount is received by
Something ends or stops ·
November 17, 2026, your electric service will be
in 13 days
disconnected on or after November 19, 2026.”
What you need to do
To avoid disconnection, pay the past-due amount online at www.gvec.example, by phone at
1-888-555-0151, or at any authorized payment location.
Ask your doctor to send us a medical certificate before your disconnection date.
Call us to learn more.
What happens if you do nothing
Unless payment of the past-due amount is received by November 17, 2026, your electric service will
be disconnected on or after November 19, 2026.
A reconnection fee of $35.00 will be charged if your service is disconnected.
Your rights and free help
If someone in your home has a serious medical condition, you may be able to delay disconnection.
You may also be eligible for a payment plan or for energy help.
“You may also be eligible for a payment plan or for energy assistance.”
Money · Who to contact · Numbers to keep
Amount you owe
Charge
Phone
TTY (for people who are deaf or hard of hearing)

www.gvec.example
Account number
Words to know
TTY
A phone service for people who are deaf or hard of hearing.
disconnection
When the company turns off your service.
past due
Money that should already have been paid.
medical certificate
A note from a doctor that says a person in the home is seriously ill.
! This letter is written at about a grade 9 reading level. Many adults find this hard.
! Plainread helps you understand a letter. It is not legal, medical or money advice. If you are not
sure, call the phone number on the letter or ask someone you trust.
